value_offering:
Value Offering

We are a small group of seasoned Information Security Professionals — coming from an academic background, and with over 20 years of practical experience in the field — here to deliver independent, comprehensive, and actionable security assessments tailored to meet clients' business timelines and requirements.

Our team is dedicated to offering cost-effective information security support, and ensuring clients are equipped with robust solutions tailored to their needs.
cost_effective_services:
Cost-Effective Services for SMEs

  • Organizations that process, transmit, or store sensitive data, such as client Personal Identifiable Information (PII), payment transactions, or health records, and are legally obligated to comply with various information system management regulation requirements.
  • Organizations lacking in-house security expertise but unable to budget a fulltime Information Security professional, nor pay corporate prices for bug bounty and other managed security services.
  • Organizations in regulated sectors, such as e-commerce, fintech, healthtech, logistics, online services, etc.
  • Organizations that require periodic compliance audits to meet industry standards, such as PCI-DSS, ISO27k, GDPR, etc.
  • Software Development and Online Service Providers that require an independent security review before major releases or on a periodic basis.
